item.title: Album Low Roar-0
item.description:
Muy recientemente empezamos a charlar con los chicos sobre la implementacion de un reproductor de mp3 en el blog, entonces me puse a investigar varias opciones, ninguna realmente interesante para implementarla. Termine en Internet Archive buscando un host para hotlinkear el contenido para no tener que tenerlo como estatico dentro del blog. Termine encontrandome con que Internet Archive tiene visualizacion de WebAmp, una forma de mostrar Winamp en la Web.

En su momento hable con los chicos de hacer algo similar a Winamp pero nunca me cruce con WebAmp, hasta este momento.

item.title: Pylot-The Carbon Ghost
item.description:
Intro

For some context, there’s a band called Pylot and they make electronic synthwavey music. Ive liked the music they put out for a while, my brother showed them to me like 5-6 years ago and I have not stopped listening to them.

They released a new LP (LP = album too short to be a album) and I just wanted to share my thoughts.

The links to every song and album are on the names of each respective one, I expect you to listen to each one, if you like it or not is your deal but LISTEN TO THEM.
